# voice-references

Make the reference clips a zero-shot voice cloner needs for each character, from recordings you have the rights to: split a recording into lines, join clean 6-11 s runs, transcribe them with fal speech-to-text, drop screams and noise, and build a ~25 s clone clip plus single reference clips and mood clips (angry, drunk) — Drama 3 clones best from the ~30 s clone clip (0.680 on Lamar), S2 Pro prefers a single clean clip (0.707) — then check the clips and upload them to your voice server's Modal volume.
